rv.q: All told, BACHELOR: THE UNAUTHORIZED PARODY MUSICAL is exceedingly clever, legitimately funny, and far wittier than the ABC series itself.

With a television show that was just begging to be parodied, featuring over-the-top characters and witty songs, this is an hilariously entertaining way to both warm your heart on a cold, winter Chicago evening, while offering so many laughs in the process.
Time to step away from your TV, get out to the theater and watch one of your favorite TV shows from a different perspective- have some fun.

cn.t: Critics find this Bachelor parody fresh and entertaining, with a talented cast that effectively skewers the reality show's tired tropes and melodrama in a breezy 75 minutes.
